nodes.name: Run one approved RentCast sync
nodes.notes: Before activation replace the URL and attach the n8n credential named LeadForge CRON Bearer (Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>). Each call is bounded by the app to one provider request; the route rotates eligible sources and enforces a per-source 24-hour claim.

requires: LeadForge deployment with Supabase and encryption configured
An approved and active RentCast source with valid source configuration
RentCast API credentials and contractual authorization in the LeadForge server environment
n8n HTTP Header Auth credential named LeadForge CRON Bearer
meta.safety: No scraping, email, offer, payment, or delivery action is performed by this workflow. Workflow is intentionally inactive.
